text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Osaka Hai, I haven't 
slacked on training one bit! And yet...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
A new path to becoming 'the strongest'... 
still remains unseen, doesn't it?

It was difficult to find a producing 
strategy that wouldn't be overshadowed by 
Tokai Teio's sheer prestige.

I know a superficial, half-baked attempt 
at youth won't be nearly enough, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Nature-san is also 
running in the Osaka Hai, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to have a little chat with 
Nature-san. She may not be a powerhouse on 
Teio-san's level, but...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
She is an Umamusume boasting unrivalled 
popularity, after all. Maybe she can teach 
us something.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... Do you have a moment? You're 
running in the Osaka Hai too, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Nature...-san?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. It is one of my goals for the 
spring. Plus, I thought maybe Teio might 
show up, too."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: B-But, u-u-uuuugghh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she's taking another long 
break. After showing us a race like that, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Aaaargh, geez! What kind of... What 
kind of Umamusume are you?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, Nature-san!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... But... just let me say this 
one thing...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Teio had... everything that I didn't.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sparkling, an inspiration, always smiling, 
lighting up the entire world. In that 
light...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How many times did she torment me, and how 
many times did she save me? And yet, and 
yet, she...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just when we were finally able to compete 
for real, why do you have to disappear 
again...?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're just gonna take the win and run? No 
way, that's not fair! Give me... Give me 
another chance!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I want to win! But even if I can't, that's 
fine too! I just want to run with you 
again! Again and again, as many times as 
it takes!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know how much weight you carry in my 
heart, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I know you're not taking a break just 
because you want to. Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come out, come on out... Again... 
someday...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Nature-san...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(This craving... this heat... Somewhere 
deep down, I felt a kinship with you...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I thought we might be similar in how we 
couldn't break through. But...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Standing here right now is someone who 
looks nothing like me. And... what is 
this? This feeling...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(I'm drawn to her... I want to cheer her 
on... Because of that earnest dedication. 
Even though we're rivals in the Osaka 
Hai.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... Um... I can't put it into 
words very well, but...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for telling me how you feel. I 
really didn't understand you back then. 
And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to you, maybe... I really am 
missing something!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Royce...? No, I should be the one thanking 
you. For listening to me vent.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Then next— in the Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm back. I had a talk with 
Nature-san!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...And that's what happened.

It seems she was harboring an immensely 
passionate feeling deep within her heart.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, I still don't know what I should 
do. But that's precisely why—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to throw everything I have 
against Nature-san!
choice_data_list: And in doing so... you found your answer?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I want to somehow break through the 
current situation. And I feel like the 
hint for that... can be found in 
competition.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I run with Nature-san, who captivates 
everyone and has shaken my heart this 
much...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san, let's have a good match today. 
I'm going all out!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Royce. Teio might not be here, 
but... I'll do my best in my own way too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
There's something I realized I just have 
to do today.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Something I felt... I just had to do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. At last year's Arima Kinen, Teio 
proudly took on the challenge of the 
younger generation."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
She showed that true brilliance not just 
to me, but to the younger ones too. That's 
why...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Today, I think I'll do the exact same 
thing. To you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I let Teio leave me in the dust without 
showing what I've got, it'd just be way 
too lame.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Royce. I'll show you the absolute 
best running I've got!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Nature-san... Yes, I'll be counting on 
you!
